proposal.description: fault_arbiter's valley-sample lookback BLANK_CLKS is sized from the LM5106 turn-on shrinkage (7 clocks, 140 ns), as if the blanking had to cover the gate driver's delay, instead of the module's 5-clock (100 ns) default
proposal.reason: Each per-cycle valley sample at the PWM rising edge now reads CP_trig as it was 7 clocks before turn-on instead of 5. A comparator assertion that starts 5-6 clocks before turn-on is no longer counted, and one that clears in that interval is still counted. This changes when window_trip / window_trip_SS fire, and so the En shutdown into hiccup and the FAULT_COUNT telemetry.

proposal.description: pwm_mask's on-time ceiling has the LM5106 turn-on shrinkage added at the call site, so the gate on-time is meant to equal the ceiling, but the shrinkage is then counted twice because MIN_ON_COUNTS already includes it
proposal.reason: Every PWM_out pulse is now cut 7 clocks later than the ceiling soft_start produces. During soft start the floor pulse is 19 clocks instead of 12 and each ramp step is offset the same way. In S_RUN, pulses of 84-90 clocks pass where the 75% backstop should truncate them.
